content.short: Collector Crypt on TON tokenizes real collectible cards into NFTs that can be traded or redeemed.
content.description: Collector Crypt on TON turns physical collectibles into NFT equivalents on TON. Its docs explain that authenticated cards are stored in secure vaults, minted as NFTs, and can later be redeemed for the backing physical item. The Telegram Mini App also adds pack opening, raffles, points, and trading around those tokenized collectibles. It belongs in real-world assets because the token or product is tied to off-chain value, investment, property, or business activity. Collector Crypt is kept in this TON set because its product has a concrete user or builder workflow, not only a loose mention of the network.
